message.content: Starting triage on the reported failure — shrinking the scenario to isolate the breakdown.
Shrunk the failure to 26 steps — now tracing the energy spike around the violation.
Pinpointed a close encounter driving the energy violation — now testing a counter-measure.
Counterfactual confirms the large time step caused the drift — preparing the final triage report.
